bioghist.head: Biographical Information
bioghist.p: Ezra Basil Hensley was born 14 December 1910 in Albemarle County, Virginia, to William Thomas Hensley (1878-1967) and Maggie Lee Haney Hensley (1873-1924). Hensley became an operating engineer in construction. During World War II, he was a technician level 5 in the United States Army. After the war, he returned to work as an operating engineer, settling in Alexandria, Virginia. Hensley died 8 Marcy 1986 in Alexandria. He married Grace Mae Wood on 29 June 1946. Grace Wood was born 8 January 1924 in Albemarle County to Ray Otto Wood (1892-1961) and Mattie Allen Wood (1890-1980). Grace Hensley died 8 June 2002 in Spotsylvania County, Virginia. Both Hensleys are buried in the National Cemetery at Quantico, Virginia. They had two daughters, Grace Elaine Hensley and Melva Allen Hensley.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: Papers, 1938-1986, of the Hensley family of Alexandria, Virginia, consisting of papers, 1938-1986, of Ezra Basil Hensley (1910-1986) concerning his service in the United States army and his career as an operating engineer; grade cards, 1930-1941, of Grace Wood (Hensley) (1924-2002) and book on child-rearing; grade cards and papers, 1958-1979, for Grace Elaine Hensley and Melva Allen Hensley attending Fairfax County, Virginia, public schools and Northern Virginia Community College.
